Definition: Elishama, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elishama is the name of seven Israelites. In Numbers 1:10, the text says "Elishama the son of Ammihud." The life behind the name is told on the Elishama People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elishama matters because God knows His people by name, and Elishama is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
